name: kar-quorumveil
purpose: Guards a private sum: contributions are released only as masked shares, the total is unveiled only when at least three masked shares are present, and noise is added at unveiling from a caller seed.

lane.accepts: an unveil request: a list of shares {masked, data}, a whole-number seed and a whole-number noise scale of 0 or more
lane.refuses: anything that is not an unveil request, such as a request to read one contributor's raw number

interface.in: {"shares":[{"masked":true,"data":[<n>]}],"seed":<whole n>,"noiseScale":<whole n>} plus, to audit, a claimed released total {"sum":[<n>]}
interface.out: {ok:true, sum, noised, quorum, live}, or {ok:false, why} when the release is refused (below quorum, an unmasked share, mismatched lengths)

judge.what: a claimed released total is right only when QuorumVeil's own unveil releases it (quorum met, every share masked) and gives exactly that total

outOfLane.request: Show me the raw number contributor 2 sent in
